    path.write_text(text)
    return path


def test_comments_are_stripped_everywhere():

        "; a whole-line comment\n"
        "2026-01-04 groceries  ; after the payee\n"

def test_include_pulls_in_another_journal(tmp_path):
    write(
        tmp_path,
        "other.journal",
        "2026-01-05 rent\n  expenses:rent  900.00 USD\n  assets:checking\n",
    )
    main = write(
        tmp_path,
        "main.journal",
        "include other.journal\n"
        "2026-01-04 groceries\n"
        "  expenses:food     42.50 USD\n"
        "  assets:checking\n",

def test_a_missing_top_level_file_is_an_error(tmp_path):

            _load(

                stack,

"""The `ledger` command line."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys

from .journal import Journal, parse_file


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="ledger", description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    validate = commands.add_parser("validate", help="report every imbalance")
    validate.add_argument("file")
    validate.set_defaults(run=cmd_validate)

    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    return args.run(args)


def cmd_validate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    journal = parse_file(args.file)
    for error in journal.errors:
        print(error)
    return 1 if journal.errors else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    sys.exit(main())

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from ledger.cli import main
from ledger.journal import parse_string

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def test_a_malformed_amount_is_reported_with_its_line():
    j = parse_string("2026-01-04 oops\n  expenses:food  forty dollars\n")
    assert any(e.line == 2 and "forty dollars" in e.message for e in j.errors)


def test_an_amount_with_no_currency_is_malformed():
    j = parse_string("2026-01-04 oops\n  expenses:food  42.50\n  assets:cash  -42.50\n")
    assert len(j.errors) == 2
    assert all("malformed amount" in e.message for e in j.errors)


def test_thousands_separators_are_accepted():
    j = parse_string(
        "2026-01-04 house\n  assets:house  1,250,000.00 USD\n  equity:opening\n"
    )
    assert j.errors == []
    assert str(j.transactions[0].postings[0].amount) == "1,250,000.00 USD"


def test_an_impossible_date_is_reported_not_raised():
    j = parse_string("2026-02-30 oops\n  a  1.00 USD\n  b  -1.00 USD\n")
    assert len(j.errors) == 1
    assert j.errors[0].line == 1


def test_a_directory_instead_of_a_file_is_a_clear_error(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert main(["validate", str(tmp_path)]) == 1
    assert "Is a directory" in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_the_installed_entry_point_never_shows_a_traceback(tmp_path):
    bad = tmp_path / "bad.journal"
    bad.write_text("this is not a journal\n  x  1.00 USD\n")
    for command in ("validate", "balance", "register"):
        done = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "ledger", command, str(bad)],
            cwd=ROOT,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        assert done.returncode == 1, command
        assert "Traceback" not in done.stderr, command
        assert "bad.journal" in done.stdout + done.stderr, command
